name: Sugar Rush Xmas

features.name: Cluster pays
features.description: Five or more touching symbols form a win on the 7x7 grid, followed by a cascade.

features.name: Multiplier spots
features.description: Winning positions are marked; repeat wins on a marked spot create a multiplier that doubles up to 128x.

features.name: Persistent free spins
features.description: 3–7 scatters award 10–30 free spins in which marked spots and multipliers are kept for the whole round.

review:
Sugar Rush in snow and Christmas sweets – same game underneath. Five or more matching treats touching up, down or sideways win, explode and refill.

Each winning spot gets marked, and a second win there starts a multiplier that doubles with every hit, up to 128x. In the base game marks clear after the spin; in the 10 to 30 free spins they stay, so the bonus gets stronger the longer it lasts. Expect plenty of quiet bonuses for every big one. Up to 5,000x.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
